simple.meaning: סַף (çaph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 32 times across Exodus, Judges, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, and 9 more, beginning at Exodus 12:22. Its contexts include blood, death, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סַף (H5592).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סַף (çaph) / H5592 is traced through Exodus 12:22, Judges 19:27, 2 Samuel 17:28, 1 Kings 7:50 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5592. caph I. סַף noun masculine basin, goblet (Late Hebrew סַף ; Phoenician סף (Inscription of Tyre (1), 5, 6 ) Schröd ZMG xxxix (1886), 317 f. ClGann Annales du Musée Guimet x. 511 = Recuell d'arch. orient.(1886), 89 Hal RŠJ xii.107 Bloch; but Lzb 330 door-sill) ; — ׳ס absolute basin Exod 12:22 (twice in verse) (J; containing blood of passover lamb); construct סַףרַֿעַל Zech 12:2 goblet of reeling (intoxicating, figurative), probably also Hab 2:15 , where read חֲמָֽתְךָ מִסַּף from the goblet of thy fury (for ח ׳מְסַמֵּחַ ᵑ0 , see I. ספח ); plural absolute סַמּוֺת 2Sam 17:28 basins for ordinary use; הַסִּמִּים Jer 52:19 , הַסִמּוֺת 1Kin 7:50 and construct כֶּסֶף סִמּוֺת 2Kin 12:14 , of temple utensils. II. סַף noun masculine Amos 9:1 threshold, sill (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician see Lzb 1 . סַף ; Aramaic סִמָּא , Arabic sippu Dl 509, all id. ); — absolute ׳ס 2Kin 12:10 +, also הַסָּ֑ף Judg 19:27 3 t. (Baer Ginsb), הַסָּ֑ף 2Kin 25:8 ; suffix סִמִּי Ezek 43:8 , סִמָּם 43:8 ; plural סִמִּים Amos 9:1 ; Isa 6:4 6 t. Ezra, Chronicles; — threshold, sill Judg 19:27 ; Amos 9:1 ; Isa 6:4 ; Ezek 41:16 (twice in verse); 43:8 (twice in verse); 2Chr 3:7 , ׳ס הַבַּיִת 1Kin 14:17 , ׳ס הַשַּׁעַר Ezek 40:6-7 , compare 40:6 b הַסַּף שֹׁמֵרֹ = door-keeper , an important temple official, Jer 35:4 , so הַסּ ׳שֹׁמְרֵי 2Kin 12:10 (priests), 22:4 2Chr 34:9 (Levites!), 2Kin 23:4 ; 25:18 = Jer 52:24 ; in Persia, of palace Est 2:21 ; 6:2 ; of tabernacle ׳שׁ הַסִּמִּים 1Chr 9:19 ; ׳הַסּ שֹׁעֲרֵי 2Chr 23:4 (Levites), בַּסּ ׳שֹׁעֲרִים 1Chr 9:22 ; collective בַּסָּ֑ף חֹרֶב Zeph 2:14 desolation in the thresholds .
